payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a TCP-port list. Accepts a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive; booleans are rejected because a boolean is not an integer. Missing, null, scalar, empty, bool-element and out-of-range inputs fail closed by returning valid=false with ports=[]; no exception is raised. Returns {valid: boolean, ports: original list when valid else []}. Target interface: the consuming Recipe supplies the typed ports value through the step-local inputs["ports"] mapping. Typed inputs are a target interface, not guaranteed deployed runtime support; the typed runner must be implemented before this component executes.
